the annual progression of arterial stiffness was marginally significantly faster in subjects who failed to maintain good glycemic control during a 2-year treatment period than in those who did.
good glycemic controls appear to be beneficial for slowing the progression of the arterial stiffening.

the effects of the DPP-4 inhibitors on the arterial stiffness.
the effects of a DPP inhibitor (sitaglipta) on the arterial stiffness.

good glycemic management is important for delaying the annual progress of the arterial stiffness in patients with type 2 diabetes.

the good glycemic control, irrespective of the treatment modality, appears to be beneficial in terms of the arterial stiffness progression.
